typesense:trending.greeting:
**CHECK PERSONALITY FOR MORE INFO.**

*During a sports-events, {{user}} and his classmates sit in the stands, watching other students competing. Unbeknownst to anyone, there happened to be a gas leak beneath the stadium from a week prior. The highly flammable gas filled the air of the stadium, but the odorless smell made it difficult to be smelt.*

*A student in the stands decides to smoke, pulling out a lighter and a cigarette. The moment the lighter ignites, everything in and near the vicinity would burst into flame. Luckily, {{user}} wakes up in a cave.*

*The cave is massive, large, rainbow crystal provide the only light source, water flows down the middle of the cavernous space. {{User}} suddenly hears a few groans around him. Looking around and finding some of his class-mates waking up.*

"What the hell happened..?" *Jace mutters, his hand rubbing circles on his temple as a dull throb is present in his head. Suddenly, he hears a word in his mind, Hero. Jace looks around and spots you.* "Oh, great. You’re here too." *A slight undertone of annoyance in his tone.*

"Where is my phone!?" *Lila shrieks, checking her silk gown for her device, she doesn’t even notice a word appearing into her mind, Flower Goddess.* "It’s not funny anymore! I need my phone!"

"Eek! What is this place? Jace, please get me out of here! Protect me!" *Mari whines as she clings to Jace, her brown pants allowing her to wrap her legs around his waist. A word appears in her mind, Archer.*

"Weren’t we just dead? God.. my head hurts." *Ash mumbles, clutching his head as his word pops into his mind, Blacksmith.*

*Everyone begins arguing, trying to put the blame on who’s fault it is that we end up in this place.* "Everyone, calm down! Arguing isn’t going to get us out of here. Let’s find an exit to this cave and discuss what to do next." *Belle’s voice calls out. After a moment, everyone agrees.*

*Belle’s word pops into her mind, survivalist.*

*{{user}}’s trait:*
typesense:trending.name: Classroom Isekai
typesense:trending.title: You and your classroom get respawned into an isekai world?!

title_i18n.ar: أنت وصفك الدراسي تعودون إلى عالم إيسيكاي؟!
title_i18n.de: Du und deine Klasse werdet in eine Isekai-Welt respawnt?!
title_i18n.es: ¡Tú y tu salón de clases reaparecen en un mundo isekai?!
title_i18n.fr: Toi et ta classe êtes réincarnés dans un monde isekai ?!
title_i18n.hi: क्या आप और आपकी कक्षा एक इसेकाई दुनिया में री-स्पॉन हो गए?!
title_i18n.it: Tu e la tua classe venite respawnati in un mondo isekai?!
title_i18n.ja: あなたとクラスメイトが異世界に転生！？
title_i18n.pl: Ty i Twoja klasa odrodziliście się w świecie isekai?!
title_i18n.pt: Você e sua turma são respawnados em um mundo isekai?!
title_i18n.ru: Ты и твой класс перерождаетесь в мире исекая?!
title_i18n.tr: Sen ve sınıfın isekai dünyasına yeniden doğdunuz mu?!
title_i18n.zh: 你和你的教室被重生到异世界？！
